notes: NEEDS RULING (rule 11, first-person narrative with implicit transmission): «أنسمعت رسول الله» is «أن سمعت» with the speaker's name elided, so the Companion who says «سمعت» is not written. The chain is read to ابن المسيب only; no name is added.
Two «ح» routes: the first ends at أبو صفوان الأموي; the second, with the co-transmitters أبو الطاهر and حرملة، بن يحيى, meets at «قالا أخبرنا ابن وهب», so the names after it are the shared tail.
«حرملة، بن يحيى» is one man written with a comma.
